_comment: Which bundled logo each catalogue service uses: our service slug -> the Simple Icons slug it is drawn from.
Simple Icons (https://simpleicons.org, npm simple-icons@16.33.0) is released under CC0-1.0; each icon's own source
and licence are recorded in frontend/public/service-icons/SOURCES.json by the generator.
Trademarks remain their owners'. The logos identify the service a number is for, as the brands' own guidelines allow.
Only services we actually sell appear here, and only where the icon is unambiguously the same company. Deliberately
absent: brands that asked Simple Icons to remove their marks (Microsoft, LinkedIn, Amazon, OpenAI, Yahoo, Skype,
Yandex), and look-alikes that are a different company (Gemini exchange is not Google Gemini; NetEase is not NetEase
Cloud Music; Glass is not glass.photo). Those use the generic fallback until a properly licensed logo is uploaded
Regenerate the files with: node frontend/scripts/generate-service-icons.mjs <path to node_modules/simple-icons>
